load.text.2: Tip: Confirm the game version before playing
load.text.3: Tip: Type /help in the lobby to view roles
load.text.4: Tip: Role assignment is set by the host
load.text.5: Move in the dark, watch your back
load.text.6: Complete tasks and find the impostor
load.text.7: Use skills wisely, seize the moment

role.caller.name: Caller
role.caller.des: Can force an emergency meeting at any time.
Button.Caller.label: Meeting
role.bloodthirstykiller.name: Bloodthirsty Killer
role.bloodthirstykiller.intro: You are the Bloodthirsty Killer. Kill freely!
role.crewmate.name: Crewmate
role.crewmate.des: Complete all tasks and vote out the impostor.
role.crewmate.intro: Complete tasks and find the impostor.
role.impostor.name: Impostor
role.impostor.des: Kill crewmates, sabotage, and use vents.
role.impostor.intro: Hide in the dark, strike when ready.
role.Jackal.name: Jackal
role.Jackal.shortdes: Kill everyone and take the win alone
role.Jackal.des: You are the Jackal, loyal to no side. You carry a blade, you can slip through vents, and you have no allies. After one kill you may recruit a player as your Sidekick. When yours is the only force left standing, you win alone.
role.Jackal.intro: Nobody on this ship is on your side. Not yet.
role.Sidekick.name: Sidekick
role.Sidekick.shortdes: The Jackal's ally, padding his numbers
role.Sidekick.des: You are the Jackal's Sidekick. You cannot kill, but the Jackal's blade will never find you. If the Jackal dies you take his place, and from then on you can kill and recruit in turn.
role.Sidekick.intro: You follow him, until the day you become him.
role.NiceGuesser.name: Nice Guesser
role.NiceGuesser.des: During a meeting you may guess another player's role. Guess right and they die; guess wrong and you die.
role.NiceGuesser.intro: Take the bet. Guess who they really are.
role.EvilGuesser.name: Evil Guesser
role.EvilGuesser.des: During a meeting you may guess another player's role. Guess right and they die; guess wrong and you die.
role.EvilGuesser.intro: Bet their life on your read.
role.Sheriff.name: Sheriff
role.Sheriff.des: You are the Sheriff. Shooting an impostor or neutral is safe; shooting an innocent crewmate kills you instead. Your shots are limited.
role.Sheriff.intro: Aim at the guilty, never at your own.
buff.speed_boost.name: Speed Boost
buff.speed_boost.describe: Move 30% faster for 10 seconds; ends when a meeting starts.
buff.shadow.name: Anonymous
buff.shadow.describe: All players lose cosmetics, turn gray and hide their names for 15 seconds.
